observations.contract: Garden root admission and required support
observations.trace: SceneGarden::project maps every garden plant through terrain.height_at and collects all results before from_support; absence becomes GardenSupportError::MissingSoil with plant and owner context. SceneGarden::from_support checks nonzero owner/plant identities, ordered one-to-one support membership and cardinality. The parent scene source validates garden ownership and geometry; generated active gardens are filtered to active buildings, while the source tests describe distant presentation separately.
observations.remaining: The public and derived-decoder from_support route does not itself prove full garden geometry or terrain-elevation agreement. Tiny sampled-grid numerical failure and Garden MissingSoil classification have related but not automatically identical contracts. No garden, decode, terrain or source test ran.

observations.contract: Selected obstacle clearance and controller skin
observations.trace: support_obstacles::remove reserves HUMANOID_COLLISION_RADIUS_METRES plus CharacterController::default().move_and_slide.skin_width. The selected tactical_character_controller uses a struct update from default without setting move_and_slide, and apply_motor_config changes acceleration, friction, gravity, step size and slope but does not set skin width. The selected player and iteration collider source uses the same humanoid radius constant.
observations.remaining: This is bounded structural counterevidence to assuming the selected motor configuration changes skin; native default values, other writers, component replacement, nonhumanoid bodies, support geometry and physical movement were not executed or globally proven.

observations.trace: prepare_supported_terrain calls self.validate before prepare_geographic_terrain, which separately calls validate_source before upsampling and ground construction. Grid validation requires matching heights/environment sizes. A source-only report_terrain_delta helper skips missing query pairs and prints maxima; no maximum assertion appears in that helper.
observations.remaining: Other entry paths, floating source-index behavior, generated data and any consumer outside the selected source remain open. Authored tests are specifications only.
